text:
sara_engineer: Quick question 12 I extended my trip after the Amsterdam Summit to run a post-conference workshop and paid for dinner both Saturday and Sunday out-of-pocket. Our travel policy mentions per-diem for overnight travel, but this extension was my own choice to run the workshop on Sunday. Can I submit those extra meal receipts? I'll upload them now.

anna_finance: Hi Sara 12 normally per-diem is for official overnight travel. Weekend extensions are allowed as exceptions when there's business justification + manager sign-off. Two options: (1) take the standard per-diem cap (50/day), we can auto-approve up to that with manager note, or (2) itemize receipts and submit actuals with manager approval.

sara_engineer: Got it. The two meals together are 97. One receipt is just a card total (no itemization) from a hotel restaurant. Will that pass?

anna_finance: Card totals are ok if merchant, date, and amount are visible. For the 97 total, since it's slightly under the 100 flat cap for two days, you can either claim 100 flat or submit 97 with receipts + manager sign-off. We need leo_ops or your manager to confirm that the extra night was business-related.

leo_ops: I confirm I asked Sara to stay to run the workshop on Sunday. Approving the extension for business reasons. @anna_finance please mark manager_approved=yes for Sara's submission.

sara_engineer: Thanks @leo_ops! Is there a specific dropdown to mark "manager-approved exception" in the expense portal?

reimburse-bot: Submission template (please paste into the expense notes):
``
expense_type: travel_meals_per_diem_exception
dates: 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-15
amount_claimed: EUR 97
manager: leo_ops
manager_approval: yes
attachments: receipt_87921.jpg, hotel_card_total_87922.pdf, workshop_agenda.pdf
notes: stayed extra to lead workshop; itemized + card total attached
```

julie_peopleops: Quick FYI: when it's manager-approved but weekend-extension, People Ops prefers a short note in the record explaining why the extension was necessary (helps audits).

anna_finance: Thanks everyone. Sara, once you submit with the template I'll process it. If you choose the flat-rate 100 we can auto-approve immediately; itemized will need verification but usually clears within 5-7 business days.

sara_engineer: Submitted now (expense ID 88042) with receipts and the agenda. Chose itemize. Thanks all :relieved:
